items.source: Note that there is also a priority marker for this interface: PriorityOrdered. Consult the Javadoc for PriorityOrdered for details on how PriorityOrdered objects are ordered relative to plain Ordered objects.
items.translation: 注意，此接口还有一个 优先级 标记：PriorityOrdered。请查阅 PriorityOrdered 的 Javadoc，以了解 PriorityOrdered 对象相对于 普通 Ordered 对象的排序方式。

items.source: The actual order can be interpreted as prioritization, with the first object (with the lowest order value) having the highest priority.
items.translation: 实际的order可被解释为优先级，其中第一个对象（具有最低 order 值的对象）拥有最高优先级。

items.source: Consult the Javadoc for OrderComparator for details on the sort semantics for non-ordered objects.
items.translation: 有关非有序对象的排序语义的详细信息，请参阅OrderComparator的 Javadoc。

items.source: Useful constant for the highest precedence value.
items.translation: 用于最高优先级值的有效常量。

items.source: Useful constant for the lowest precedence value.
items.translation: 用于最低优先级值的有用常量。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Get the order value of this object.
